EXTRA — Apollo 13

87 Hours to Earth

1970.04.13  EARTH → MOON → EARTH

This game is based on the Apollo 13 accident of April 1970, when an oxygen tank failed on the way to the Moon. The three men aboard turned the lunar module they were to land in into a lifeboat, and came back to Earth four days later.

It was made in respect for the people, in space and on the ground, who worked to bring the three home, and as a way to see for yourself what happened in those four days. Some conversations and scenes are fictional. Times and figures are based on sources such as NASA and Wikipedia.

This game includes scenes of an explosion, cold, and difficulty breathing. If it becomes too much, please don’t push yourself.
